desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on escalating Middle East tensions, including an IRGC strike claim in the Strait of Hormuz and U.S. intel warnings of advanced Iranian plots against Americans. Ukraine-Russia drone and missile activity also drew attention, alongside minor U.S. force posture updates. The single most important thread is the Hormuz incident and Iranian threat reporting.

## MAIN THREADS
### Strait of Hormuz / IRGC strike claim
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114353221091110963) reported an anti-ship missile launch from Iran and the IRGC claiming it struck an “offending” vessel; cited a delayed post from @hey_itsmyturn.
- [@UK_MTO](https://x.com/UK_MTO/status/2114352041795735866) issued Update 108 JMIC Advisory Note on 25 October covering maritime security in the region.

### U.S. intel on Iranian threats
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114150436932288824) summarized a WSJ report on DNI memo to SecState Rubio detailing “advanced stages” of Iranian lethal plotting against U.S. personnel in the Middle East and elsewhere, with embassy/base drawdowns noted.

### Ukraine-Russia strikes
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2114277367946588514) noted Russian channels warning of a Ukrainian Storm Shadow raid, the second in a week, after a new UK missile package.
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2114148820657283489) reported an ongoing Ukrainian attack drone raid deep into western Russia targeting the Volga basin.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114199494006915541) covered Ukraine’s announcement that Starlink/Starshield speed restrictions were lifted after nearly 11 days.

### U.S. military updates
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114349086690156595) reported SecWar Hegseth memo establishing a new Air National Guard Special Tactics Squadron in Florida near SOCOM and AFSOC.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114336436379856919) highlighted two Israeli KC-46A tankers flying together off Israel for the first time, citing @DefenceGeek.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado reportedly entered Venezuela from Colombia (unconfirmed) [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114387194274033724).
- Trump administration previously clashed with Machado over her return due to unrest risks and recent earthquakes (unconfirmed) [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2114387194274033724).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for follow-up on the Hormuz vessel strike claim and any U.S. response to Iranian plotting. Ukrainian long-range strikes and Russian air defenses remain active. Maritime advisories in the Gulf may update quickly.
